en.name: FN EVOLYS 7.62x51 light machine gun
en.description: The EVOLYS is an ultralight belt-fed machine gun developed to combine the firepower of a light machine gun with the ergonomics of an assault rifle. As such, it has found its place in military, special forces and private military applications around the world. Manufactured by FN Herstal
